registration: registered before inspecting new held-out results; no fresh hyperparameter search
decoder: frozen own-validation winner of the 52-candidate single-model search
ensemble: frozen own-validation selected subset of existing seeds
selection: same own-match weighted score and fusion/fragmentation/occlusion guards; ties retain earlier simpler variant
integrated: compare combination winner against validation-selected saved-checkpoint criterion on predeclared folds0/6 only; ties retain combined; report separately from uniform seven-fold frozen-weight comparison
test_policy: freeze combination and integrated choices from validation JSONs before reading their test rows
